'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Micah Wooten LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Micah Wooten]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title The First Transport Is Away! Starts [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]]. General Dodonna struck → [[General Walex Blissex (V)]]. Sheet Local Uprising/Liberation (V#) → [[Local Uprising / Liberation]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Micah Wooten]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
